overview.title: Automation orbit seed pack is in place
overview.summary: 13 workflows now span schedules, manual probes, and webhook experiments around the VM105 automation stack.
overview.blocker: Live dashboard polling still needs /proxy/n8n to inject X-N8N-API-KEY.
overview.usableNow: 10 usable workflows are ready in n8n now, while 3 webhook routes still need runtime follow-up.
overview.focus: Keep the orbit honest: real schedule/manual workflows now, authenticated live execution rendering next.

workflowRuns.name: Automation Orbit - Daily Auth Audit
workflowRuns.description: Daily schedule that probes auth-gated automation endpoints so you can track which routes still need credentials or proxy headers.
notes: Tracks auth-gated services so the orbit can surface blocked integrations honestly.
Useful as a daily reminder of which proxies still need credentials or headers.

workflowRuns.name: Automation Orbit - Docker Container Health -> AI Triage Report
workflowRuns.description: Hourly schedule that pulls Docker health data from VM105, sends the normalized snapshot to LM Studio for AI triage, and appends the plain-English health report to today's Logseq...
notes: Scheduled Docker health sweep for VM105 with container-state and docker-stats normalization.
Live path now uses LM Studio at 100.71.100.103:1234 with qwen/qwen3-30b-a3b-2507 and appends into Logseq through the VM105 mount with sudo.

workflowRuns.name: Automation Orbit - Hourly Stack Pulse
workflowRuns.description: Hourly schedule that checks the public VM105 automation surfaces and captures a lightweight pulse of the stack.
notes: Runs hourly and captures a lightweight pulse of the public automation stack.
Designed to give the orbit a dependable schedule-based backbone.

workflowRuns.name: Automation Orbit - Protected Service Probe
workflowRuns.description: Manual probe for auth-gated services so you can confirm the service is alive even when credentials are missing.
notes: On-demand probe for credentialed services such as n8n public API and Qdrant.
Helpful for confirming a service is alive even before auth is wired through.

workflowRuns.name: Automation Orbit - Public Service Sweep
workflowRuns.description: Manual probe for public VM105 service endpoints that do not require credentials.
notes: One-click manual sweep for public VM105 endpoints.
Safe editor-side probe when you want to inspect raw responses without credentials.

workflowRuns.name: Automation Orbit - n8n Settings Webhook
workflowRuns.description: GET webhook wrapper around the local n8n public settings endpoint.
notes: Intended as a simple GET wrapper around the local n8n settings endpoint.
Needs the production webhook route issue solved before it is truly external-facing.

workflowRuns.name: Automation Orbit - Ops Intake Webhook
workflowRuns.description: POST webhook that normalizes incoming payloads into a simple ops-intake envelope for future automations.
notes: Production webhook activation is published, but the route is still not resolving at runtime.
Keep this in the orbit as a future ingress point for dashboard and alert traffic.

workflowRuns.name: Automation Orbit - TTS Health Webhook
workflowRuns.description: GET webhook wrapper around the local TTS API health endpoint.
notes: Intended as a lightweight health relay for the local TTS service.
Published in n8n, but still blocked by the unresolved production route registration.

nextIdeas: Inject X-N8N-API-KEY through /proxy/n8n so the orbit can use live workflow and execution history.
Turn the summary card into an inspector with trigger type, targets, cadence, and direct route details.
Route dashboard alerts and voice-bridge events into Ops Intake once webhook production URLs resolve.
Persist daily auth-audit summaries into the memory system or Logseq vault for trend tracking.
Keep a Claude-ready workflow clause beside the seed pack so new automations follow the same orbit conventions.
claudeWorkflowClause: Build n8n workflows for the Automation Orbit using clear names that start with 'Automation Orbit -', prefer manual or schedule triggers unless public webhook routing is verified, target real VM105 services when possible, return normalized JSON, and include a short description of trigger, purpose, and external dependencies.
